description: Escape or unescape a string for a target: JSON (string body), JavaScript (incl. template literals), HTML, XML, URL (encodeURIComponent, optional form +), SQL (doubled quotes, optional MySQL backslashes and wrapping quotes), CSV field (RFC 4180; comma, semicolon or tab), regex, POSIX shell single quotes, C/C++, Java/C#, and Unicode escapes (\uXXXX, \u{X}, \UXXXXXXXX, &#xX;, U+XXXX). Options per target as on the website. Set "allTargets" to get the escaped form for every target at once. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/text-escape/

allTargets.description: escape only: also return the text escaped for every target.

ascii.description: json/js/html/c/java: also escape non-ASCII characters (c: as UTF-8 octal).

delimiter.description: csv: field delimiter (comma, semicolon or tab).

every.description: unicode: escape every character, not only non-ASCII.

named.description: html (with ascii): prefer named entities such as ©.

target.description: Format: json, js, html, xml, url, sql, csv, regex, shell, c, java, unicode.

text.description: The text to escape, or the escaped text to unescape.

unicodeFormat.description: unicode: u4 = \uXXXX (JS, JSON, Java), ubrace = \u{X} (ES6, Rust, Swift), u8 = \UXXXXXXXX (Python, C), html = &#xX;, uplus = U+XXXX.

wrap.description: sql: wrap in single quotes (unescape: strip them).

name: text_escape
title: Escape / unescape text
